elsewhere.note: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.
Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
even Jesus of Nazareth, how God anointed him with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil…
and don’t give place to the devil.
not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.
and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to his will.
and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,
